access_note: Pre-release code shared with external collaborators through a private repository.
description: GLOBIOM is IIASA's global land-use model of agriculture and forestry, documented on a site that describes the model and maps its GAMS code. It represents six land cover types with economic activity (cropland, grassland, short rotation plantations, managed and unmanaged forests, and other natural vegetation) plus three fixed types, and determines land conversion endogenously for each grid cell from the profitability of production activities, conversion costs, biophysical suitability and a matrix of allowed land cover transitions. Crop productivity per grid cell comes from the EPIC crop model. The model covers livestock and forestry management and greenhouse gas mitigation options, including technologies from the EPA mitigation option database, and computes the economically optimal combination of measures under a GHG price. Coverage is global, with a European variant with G4M for LULUCF estimates. Access is restricted: an open-source version is in preparation, and external collaborators get a pre-release in a private GitHub repository; the documentation is public. No licence is stated. Caveats: running it requires the code, GAMS and solvers, and the public site describes the Trunk version only. For simulation it projects land use, agricultural and forestry production and emissions for climate policy and food-security scenarios. Related catalogue records include MAgPIE and GTAP.
